title: The €963 Book Launch That Made Me Wish To Get Back To My Secured Job
content:
<html><head></head><body>Exactly 365 days ago, I released my first ebook. I always wanted to share my experiences about it, but I never felt comfortable enough to do so. The project didn't turn out as expected, and I felt embarrassed. It's time to finally reflect it and to overcome my fears.
            </body></html>
